description: A small white cubby-style shelf sits in the back-right corner of the desk with a couple of books inside, and a few other books lie on the tabletop near the bottom edge. The right hand reaches into the cubby, grips a book, and pulls it straight out toward the center of the desk to set it down, then reaches back in to remove a second book and places it beside the first; the left hand stays near the front, mostly idle and not touching anything.
